```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(DT)
})

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 14))

# Read data
summary_df <- read.delim(params$summary_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
detail_df <- read.delim(params$detail_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
params_df <- read.delim(params$params_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Read coverage data if available (run-length encoded intervals)
has_coverage <- nchar(params$coverage_file) > 0 && file.exists(params$coverage_file)
if (has_coverage) {
  coverage_intervals <- read.delim(params$coverage_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Read species calls if available (from --identify step)
has_species_calls <- nchar(params$species_calls_file) > 0 && file.exists(params$species_calls_file)
if (has_species_calls) {
  species_calls <- read.delim(params$species_calls_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Convert interval-format coverage to plottable points for a single reference.
# For small references (<=max_points positions) expands to per-position data.
# For large references, bins intervals into at most max_points summary points.
# Input: data frame with columns start, end, depth (for one reference_id)
# Output: data frame with columns reference_id, position, depth
expand_intervals <- function(interval_df, max_points = 2000) {
  if (nrow(interval_df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(reference_id = character(), position = integer(), depth = numeric()))
  }
  ref_id <- interval_df$reference_id[1]
  total_len <- max(interval_df$end) - min(interval_df$start) + 1L

  if (total_len <= max_points) {
    # Small reference: expand fully
    positions <- unlist(mapply(seq, interval_df$start, interval_df$end, SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
    depths <- rep(interval_df$depth, interval_df$end - interval_df$start + 1L)
    return(data.frame(reference_id = ref_id, position = positions, depth = depths))
  }

  # Large reference: bin intervals into max_points bins
  genome_start <- min(interval_df$start)
  genome_end <- max(interval_df$end)
  bin_size <- (genome_end - genome_start + 1) / max_points
  bin_edges <- genome_start + bin_size * (0:max_points)

  bin_depth_sum <- numeric(max_points)
  bin_width <- numeric(max_points)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(interval_df))) {
    iv_start <- interval_df$start[i]
    iv_end   <- interval_df$end[i]
    iv_depth <- interval_df$depth[i]
    # Find which bins this interval overlaps
    first_bin <- max(1L, ceiling((iv_start - genome_start) / bin_size))
    last_bin  <- min(max_points, ceiling((iv_end - genome_start) / bin_size))
    if (first_bin > max_points || last_bin < 1L) next
    first_bin <- max(1L, first_bin)
    last_bin  <- min(max_points, last_bin)
    for (b in first_bin:last_bin) {
      overlap_start <- max(iv_start, bin_edges[b])
      overlap_end   <- min(iv_end, bin_edges[b + 1] - 1)
      overlap_len   <- overlap_end - overlap_start + 1
      if (overlap_len > 0) {
        bin_depth_sum[b] <- bin_depth_sum[b] + iv_depth * overlap_len
        bin_width[b]     <- bin_width[b] + overlap_len
      }
    }
  }

  avg_depth <- ifelse(bin_width > 0, bin_depth_sum / bin_width, 0)
  bin_centers <- (bin_edges[1:max_points] + bin_edges[2:(max_points + 1)]) / 2

  data.frame(reference_id = ref_id, position = bin_centers, depth = avg_depth)
}

# --- Pipeline flow diagram helpers ---

# Generate a sigmoid-curved flow polygon between two bar segments.
make_flow_polygon <- function(x0, x1, y0_top, y0_bot, y1_top, y1_bot,
                              id, fill, n_points = 50) {
  t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_points)
  smooth_t <- 3 * t^2 - 2 * t^3  # Hermite ease-in-out
  x_fwd <- x0 + (x1 - x0) * t
  top_fwd <- y0_top + (y1_top - y0_top) * smooth_t
  bot_fwd <- y0_bot + (y1_bot - y0_bot) * smooth_t
  data.frame(
    x = c(x_fwd, rev(x_fwd)),
    y = c(top_fwd, rev(bot_fwd)),
    id = id,
    fill = fill,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Stack segments top-to-bottom within a y-range. Returns data.frame with
# ymin, ymax for each value. Zero-valued segments get zero height.
stack_segments <- function(values, y_top = 1.0, y_bot = 0.0, gap = 0.008) {
  n <- length(values)
  total <- sum(values)
  n_nonzero <- sum(values > 0)
  if (total == 0 || n_nonzero == 0) {
    return(data.frame(ymin = rep(y_bot, n), ymax = rep(y_bot, n)))
  }
  total_gap <- gap * max(0, n_nonzero - 1)
  available <- y_top - y_bot - total_gap
  heights <- (values / total) * available
  ymax <- numeric(n)
  ymin <- numeric(n)
  current_y <- y_top
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    if (values[i] > 0) {
      ymax[i] <- current_y
      ymin[i] <- current_y - heights[i]
      current_y <- ymin[i] - gap
    } else {
      ymax[i] <- current_y
      ymin[i] <- current_y
    }
  }
  data.frame(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax)
}

# Custom pipeline flow diagram using ggplot2 with sigmoid-curved flow bands.
pipeline_flow_diagram <- function(
    fragments_generated, fragments_captured,
    sample_captured, nonsample_target_captured, distractor_captured,
    untargeted_captured = 0,
    reads_sequenced = 0, reads_after_filter = 0,
    reads_correctly_mapped, reads_incorrectly_mapped, reads_unmapped = 0,
    distractor_fraction = NA,
    zoom_ratio = 0.85) {

  not_captured <- fragments_generated - fragments_captured
  sequencing_changed <- (reads_sequenced > 0) && (reads_sequenced != fragments_captured)
  filtering_applied <- (reads_after_filter > 0)
  has_sources <- !is.na(distractor_fraction) && distractor_fraction > 0

  # --- Zoom scaling ---
  if (sequencing_changed) {
    zoom_label <- "Sequenced"
    zoom_count <- reads_sequenced
    sampling_loss <- fragments_captured - reads_sequenced
  } else {
    zoom_label <- "Captured"
    zoom_count <- fragments_captured
    sampling_loss <- 0
  }

  # Pre-filter input count
  pre_filter_count <- zoom_count
  if (filtering_applied) {
    host_removed <- pre_filter_count - reads_after_filter
    pre_mapping_count <- reads_after_filter
  } else {
    host_removed <- 0
    pre_mapping_count <- zoom_count
  }

  # --- Column x-positions ---
  bar_hw <- 0.025  # bar half-width
  columns <- c("generated", "capture", "zoom")
  if (sequencing_changed) columns <- append(columns, "seq_loss", after = 2)
  # Actually: capture column has Captured+Not Captured; zoom is the expanded bar
  # Rethink: columns are just stage positions
  col_names <- "generated"
  if (has_sources) col_names <- c("source", col_names)
  col_names <- c(col_names, "capture", "zoom")
  if (filtering_applied) col_names <- c(col_names, "filter")
  col_names <- c(col_names, "mapping")

  n_cols <- length(col_names)
  col_x <- setNames(seq(0.06, 0.94, length.out = n_cols), col_names)

  # Widen the gap between capture and zoom for the expansion effect
  if ("zoom" %in% col_names) {
    cap_idx <- which(col_names == "capture")
    zoom_idx <- which(col_names == "zoom")
    if (zoom_idx - cap_idx == 1 && n_cols > 2) {
      # Give extra space by shifting zoom and everything after slightly right
      spacing <- col_x[2] - col_x[1]  # base spacing
      col_x[zoom_idx] <- col_x[cap_idx] + spacing * 1.3
      # Re-distribute remaining columns after zoom
      if (zoom_idx < n_cols) {
        remaining <- col_names[(zoom_idx + 1):n_cols]
        col_x[remaining] <- seq(col_x[zoom_idx] + spacing,
                                0.94, length.out = length(remaining))
      }
    }
  }

  # Collect bars and flows
  bars <- list()
  flows <- list()
  labels <- list()
  flow_id <- 0

  add_bar <- function(name, cx, ymin, ymax, fill) {
    bars[[length(bars) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      xmin = cx - bar_hw, xmax = cx + bar_hw,
      ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  add_flow <- function(x0, x1, y0_top, y0_bot, y1_top, y1_bot, fill) {
    flow_id <<- flow_id + 1
    flows[[length(flows) + 1]] <<- make_flow_polygon(
      x0, x1, y0_top, y0_bot, y1_top, y1_bot,
      id = flow_id, fill = fill
    )
  }

  add_label <- function(x, y, text, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.2, color = "black") {
    labels[[length(labels) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      x = x, y = y, label = text, hjust = hjust, size = size,
      color = color, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  fmt <- function(n) format(n, big.mark = ",")
  pct <- function(n, total) sprintf("%.1f%%", n / total * 100)

  # --- Colors ---
  col_sample <- "#27ae60"
  col_distractor <- "#e74c3c"
  col_generated <- "#3498db"
  col_captured <- "#2ecc71"
  col_not_captured <- "#c0392b"
  col_sequenced <- "#2980b9"
  col_loss <- "#e74c3c"
  col_filtered <- "#2980b9"
  col_host_removed <- "#e74c3c"
  col_correct <- "#27ae60"
  col_incorrect <- "#e74c3c"
  col_unmapped <- "#95a5a6"
  col_nonsample <- "#e67e22"

  # =================================================================
  # COLUMN: Sources (optional)
  # =================================================================
  if (has_sources) {
    src_x <- col_x["source"]
    sample_gen <- round(fragments_generated * (1 - distractor_fraction))
    distractor_gen <- fragments_generated - sample_gen
    src_segs <- stack_segments(c(sample_gen, distractor_gen), 1.0, 0.0, gap = 0.015)

    add_bar("Sample", src_x, src_segs$ymin[1], src_segs$ymax[1], col_sample)
    add_bar("Distractor", src_x, src_segs$ymin[2], src_segs$ymax[2], col_distractor)

    add_label(src_x, (src_segs$ymin[1] + src_segs$ymax[1]) / 2,
              sprintf("Sample\n%s", fmt(sample_gen)), size = 2.8)
    add_label(src_x, (src_segs$ymin[2] + src_segs$ymax[2]) / 2,
              sprintf("Distractor\n%s", fmt(distractor_gen)), size = 2.8)

    # Flows: Source -> Generated
    gen_x <- col_x["generated"]
    add_flow(src_x + bar_hw, gen_x - bar_hw,
             src_segs$ymax[1], src_segs$ymin[1], 1.0, 1.0 - sample_gen / fragments_generated,
             col_sample)
    add_flow(src_x + bar_hw, gen_x - bar_hw,
             src_segs$ymax[2], src_segs$ymin[2],
             1.0 - sample_gen / fragments_generated, 0.0,
             col_distractor)
  }

  # =================================================================
  # COLUMN: Generated
  # =================================================================
  gen_x <- col_x["generated"]
  add_bar("Generated", gen_x, 0.0, 1.0, col_generated)
  add_label(gen_x, 0.5,
            sprintf("Generated\n%s", fmt(fragments_generated)), size = 3.2)

  # =================================================================
  # COLUMN: Capture split (Captured top, Not Captured bottom)
  # =================================================================
  cap_x <- col_x["capture"]
  cap_frac <- fragments_captured / fragments_generated

  # Position Captured at top, Not Captured at bottom with a gap
  cap_gap <- 0.03
  cap_ymax <- 1.0
  cap_ymin <- 1.0 - cap_frac * (1.0 - cap_gap)
  nc_ymax <- cap_ymin - cap_gap
  nc_ymin <- 0.0

  # Enforce minimum visible height for captured when very small
  min_bar_height <- 0.02
  if ((cap_ymax - cap_ymin) < min_bar_height && fragments_captured > 0) {
    cap_ymin <- cap_ymax - min_bar_height
    nc_ymax <- cap_ymin - cap_gap
  }

  add_bar("Captured", cap_x, cap_ymin, cap_ymax, col_captured)
  if (not_captured > 0) {
    add_bar("Not Captured", cap_x, nc_ymin, nc_ymax, col_not_captured)
  }

  add_label(cap_x, (cap_ymin + cap_ymax) / 2,
            sprintf("Captured\n%s (%s)", fmt(fragments_captured),
                    pct(fragments_captured, fragments_generated)),
            size = 2.8)
  if (not_captured > 0) {
    add_label(cap_x, (nc_ymin + nc_ymax) / 2,
              sprintf("Not Captured\n%s (%s)", fmt(not_captured),
                      pct(not_captured, fragments_generated)),
              size = 2.8)
  }

  # Flows: Generated -> Captured / Not Captured
  add_flow(gen_x + bar_hw, cap_x - bar_hw,
           1.0, 1.0 - cap_frac, cap_ymax, cap_ymin, col_captured)
  if (not_captured > 0) {
    add_flow(gen_x + bar_hw, cap_x - bar_hw,
             1.0 - cap_frac, 0.0, nc_ymax, nc_ymin, col_not_captured)
  }

  # =================================================================
  # COLUMN: Zoom (expanded bar)
  # =================================================================
  zoom_x <- col_x["zoom"]
  zoom_height <- zoom_ratio

  # Stack within zoomed area: main flow + sampling loss (if sequencing changed)
  if (sequencing_changed && sampling_loss > 0) {
    zoom_segs <- stack_segments(c(zoom_count, sampling_loss),
                                y_top = 1.0, y_bot = 1.0 - zoom_height, gap = 0.015)
    zoom_ymax <- zoom_segs$ymax[1]
    zoom_ymin <- zoom_segs$ymin[1]
    loss_ymax <- zoom_segs$ymax[2]
    loss_ymin <- zoom_segs$ymin[2]

    add_bar("Sampling Loss", zoom_x, loss_ymin, loss_ymax, col_loss)
    add_label(zoom_x, (loss_ymin + loss_ymax) / 2,
              sprintf("Sampling Loss\n%s", fmt(sampling_loss)), size = 2.5)

    # Flow from captured to sampling loss
    add_flow(cap_x + bar_hw, zoom_x - bar_hw,
             cap_ymin + (cap_ymax - cap_ymin) * (sampling_loss / fragments_captured),
             cap_ymin,
             loss_ymax, loss_ymin, col_loss)
  } else {
    zoom_ymax <- 1.0
    zoom_ymin <- 1.0 - zoom_height
  }

  add_bar(zoom_label, zoom_x, zoom_ymin, zoom_ymax, col_sequenced)
  add_label(zoom_x, (zoom_ymin + zoom_ymax) / 2,
            sprintf("%s\n%s", zoom_label, fmt(zoom_count)), size = 3.0)

  # Flow: Captured -> Zoom (expanding flow!)
  if (sequencing_changed && sampling_loss > 0) {
    # Flow to sequenced portion only
    add_flow(cap_x + bar_hw, zoom_x - bar_hw,
             cap_ymax,
             cap_ymin + (cap_ymax - cap_ymin) * (sampling_loss / fragments_captured),
             zoom_ymax, zoom_ymin, col_captured)
  } else {
    # Full captured -> zoom
    add_flow(cap_x + bar_hw, zoom_x - bar_hw,
             cap_ymax, cap_ymin, zoom_ymax, zoom_ymin, col_captured)
  }

  # =================================================================
  # Track previous stage for downstream flows
  # =================================================================
  prev_x <- zoom_x
  prev_ymin <- zoom_ymin
  prev_ymax <- zoom_ymax
  prev_count <- zoom_count

  # =================================================================
  # COLUMN: Filter (optional)
  # =================================================================
  if (filtering_applied) {
    filt_x <- col_x["filter"]
    filt_height <- zoom_height * (reads_after_filter / zoom_count)
    removed_height <- zoom_height * (host_removed / zoom_count)

    if (host_removed > 0) {
      filt_segs <- stack_segments(c(reads_after_filter, host_removed),
                                  y_top = prev_ymax, y_bot = prev_ymin, gap = 0.015)
      filt_ymax <- filt_segs$ymax[1]
      filt_ymin <- filt_segs$ymin[1]
      rem_ymax <- filt_segs$ymax[2]
      rem_ymin <- filt_segs$ymin[2]

      add_bar("Host Removed", filt_x, rem_ymin, rem_ymax, col_host_removed)
      add_label(filt_x, (rem_ymin + rem_ymax) / 2,
                sprintf("Host Removed\n%s", fmt(host_removed)), size = 2.5)

      # Flow to host removed
      prev_split <- prev_ymin + (prev_ymax - prev_ymin) * (host_removed / prev_count)
      add_flow(prev_x + bar_hw, filt_x - bar_hw,
               prev_split, prev_ymin, rem_ymax, rem_ymin, col_host_removed)
      # Flow to filtered
      add_flow(prev_x + bar_hw, filt_x - bar_hw,
               prev_ymax, prev_split, filt_ymax, filt_ymin, col_filtered)
    } else {
      filt_ymax <- prev_ymax
      filt_ymin <- prev_ymin
      add_flow(prev_x + bar_hw, filt_x - bar_hw,
               prev_ymax, prev_ymin, filt_ymax, filt_ymin, col_filtered)
    }

    add_bar("After Host Filter", filt_x, filt_ymin, filt_ymax, col_filtered)
    add_label(filt_x, (filt_ymin + filt_ymax) / 2,
              sprintf("Filtered\n%s", fmt(reads_after_filter)), size = 2.8)

    prev_x <- filt_x
    prev_ymin <- filt_ymin
    prev_ymax <- filt_ymax
    prev_count <- reads_after_filter
  }

  # =================================================================
  # COLUMN: Mapping results
  # =================================================================
  map_x <- col_x["mapping"]
  map_values <- c(reads_correctly_mapped, reads_incorrectly_mapped, reads_unmapped)
  map_names <- c("Correctly Mapped", "Incorrectly Mapped", "Unmapped")
  map_colors <- c(col_correct, col_incorrect, col_unmapped)

  # Only include non-zero segments
  keep <- map_values > 0
  map_values <- map_values[keep]
  map_names <- map_names[keep]
  map_colors <- map_colors[keep]

  if (length(map_values) > 0) {
    map_segs <- stack_segments(map_values,
                               y_top = prev_ymax, y_bot = prev_ymin, gap = 0.012)

    # Track running position for flow source splitting
    cursor_top <- prev_ymax

    for (i in seq_along(map_values)) {
      add_bar(map_names[i], map_x, map_segs$ymin[i], map_segs$ymax[i], map_colors[i])

      label_text <- sprintf("%s\n%s (%s)", map_names[i], fmt(map_values[i]),
                            pct(map_values[i], pre_mapping_count))
      add_label(map_x + bar_hw + 0.01, (map_segs$ymin[i] + map_segs$ymax[i]) / 2,
                label_text, hjust = 0, size = 2.8)

      # Flow from previous stage to this mapping segment
      frac <- map_values[i] / prev_count
      cursor_bot <- cursor_top - (prev_ymax - prev_ymin) * frac
      add_flow(prev_x + bar_hw, map_x - bar_hw,
               cursor_top, cursor_bot,
               map_segs$ymax[i], map_segs$ymin[i],
               map_colors[i])
      cursor_top <- cursor_bot
    }
  }

  # =================================================================
  # Assemble ggplot
  # =================================================================
  bar_df <- do.call(rbind, bars)
  flow_df <- if (length(flows) > 0) do.call(rbind, flows) else NULL
  label_df <- if (length(labels) > 0) do.call(rbind, labels) else NULL

  p <- ggplot()

  if (!is.null(flow_df)) {
    p <- p + geom_polygon(data = flow_df,
                          aes(x = x, y = y, group = id, fill = fill),
                          alpha = 0.35, show.legend = FALSE)
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_rect(data = bar_df,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              fill = bar_df$fill, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_identity()

  if (!is.null(label_df)) {
    p <- p + geom_text(data = label_df,
                       aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
                       size = label_df$size, color = label_df$color,
                       lineheight = 0.9)
  }

  p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.15), ylim = c(-0.02, 1.02), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 40, 5, 5))
}

# Helper to look up a parameter value
get_param <- function(name) {
  vals <- params_df$value[params_df$parameter == name]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(vals, collapse = ", ")
}

# Build parameters table (curated subset of key parameters)
param_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Targets", "Distractors", "Probes", "Sample",
                "Capture method", "Host filtering",
                "Num fragments", "Fragment length (mean/min/max)",
                "Read length", "Distractor fraction",
                "Min match bases", "Max mismatches", "Seed"),
  Value = c(
    basename(get_param("targets")),
    paste(basename(params_df$value[params_df$parameter == "distractors"]), collapse = ", "),
    basename(get_param("probes")),
    ifelse(get_param("sample") == "none", "all targets", basename(get_param("sample"))),
    get_param("capture_method"),
    ifelse(get_param("host_fasta") == "none", "none", basename(get_param("host_fasta"))),
    get_param("num_fragments"),
    sprintf("%s / %s / %s", get_param("fragment_length_mean"),
            get_param("fragment_length_min"), get_param("fragment_length_max")),
    get_param("read_length"),
    get_param("distractor_fraction"),
    get_param("min_match_bases"),
    get_param("max_mismatches"),
    ifelse(get_param("seed") == "none", "random", get_param("seed"))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(param_table, align = "ll")
```

```{r command, results='asis'}
# Reconstruct the baitbench command from run_params.tsv.
# This is fully data-driven: new parameters added to run_params.tsv
# appear here automatically without any template changes.
cmd_parts <- c("baitbench run")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(params_df))) {
  flag <- params_df$flag[i]
  value <- params_df$value[i]
  # Skip parameters that were not set (optional params use "none")
  if (value == "none") next
  cmd_parts <- c(cmd_parts, sprintf("  %s %s", flag, value))
}
cat("```bash\n")
cat(paste(cmd_parts, collapse = " \\\n"), "\n")
cat("```\n")
```

## Capture Summary

```{r capture-summary, fig.height=4}
not_captured <- summary_df$fragments_generated - summary_df$fragments_captured

capture_data <- data.frame(
  category = factor(c("Captured", "Not Captured"), levels = c("Captured", "Not Captured")),
  fragments = c(summary_df$fragments_captured, not_captured)
)

capture_data <- capture_data %>% filter(fragments > 0)

capture_data <- capture_data %>%
  mutate(
    pct = fragments / sum(fragments) * 100,
    label = sprintf("%s\n%s (%.1f%%)", category, format(fragments, big.mark = ","), pct)
  )

ggplot(capture_data, aes(x = "", y = fragments, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Captured" = "#2ecc71", "Not Captured" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(fill = NULL,
       subtitle = sprintf("Capture rate: %.1f%%  |  %s of %s fragments",
                          summary_df$capture_rate * 100,
                          format(summary_df$fragments_captured, big.mark = ","),
                          format(summary_df$fragments_generated, big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Captured Fragments by Source

```{r capture-source, fig.height=4}
source_levels <- c("Sample", "Non-sample Target", "Distractor")
source_values <- c(summary_df$sample_captured,
                   summary_df$nonsample_target_captured,
                   summary_df$distractor_captured)
source_colors <- c("Sample" = "#27ae60", "Non-sample Target" = "#e67e22",
                    "Distractor" = "#e74c3c")

# Include Untargeted if present and > 0
if ("untargeted_captured" %in% names(summary_df) && summary_df$untargeted_captured > 0) {
  source_levels <- c(source_levels, "Untargeted")
  source_values <- c(source_values, summary_df$untargeted_captured)
  source_colors <- c(source_colors, "Untargeted" = "#95a5a6")
}

source_data <- data.frame(
  source = factor(source_levels, levels = source_levels),
  fragments = source_values
)

source_data <- source_data %>% filter(fragments > 0)

total_captured <- sum(source_data$fragments)
source_data <- source_data %>%
  mutate(
    pct = fragments / total_captured * 100,
    label = sprintf("%s\n%s (%.1f%%)", source, format(fragments, big.mark = ","), pct)
  )

ggplot(source_data, aes(x = "", y = fragments, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = source_colors) +
  labs(fill = NULL,
       subtitle = sprintf("Total captured: %s", format(total_captured, big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

  label_vec <- c(label_vec, "FP_distractor", "TN_distractor")
}

cm_data <- data.frame(

)

  col_labels <- c("Reference ID", "Category", "Expected", "Detected",

  if (nrow(display_detail) > 20) {

```{r detection-lollipop, fig.height=max(3, min(nrow(detail_df %>% filter(reads_assigned > 0)), 50) * 0.4)}
detected_only <- detail_df %>% filter(reads_assigned > 0)
n_detected <- nrow(detected_only)

if (n_detected > 0) {
  class_colors <- c("TP" = "#27ae60", "FP_target" = "#e67e22",
                     "FP_distractor" = "#e74c3c", "UNKNOWN" = "#95a5a6")

  # Show top 50 by reads_assigned if too many references
  plot_data_lollipop <- if (n_detected > 50) {
    detected_only %>% slice_max(reads_assigned, n = 50)
  } else {
    detected_only
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_data_lollipop,
         aes(x = reorder(reference_id, reads_assigned),
             y = reads_assigned, color = classification)) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = reference_id, y = 0, yend = reads_assigned), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = if (n_detected <= 20) 4 else 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Reads Assigned", color = "Classification",
         title = if (n_detected > 50) sprintf("Top 50 of %d Detected References", n_detected)
                 else "Reads per Detected Reference") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = if (n_detected <= 20) 10 else 7))

  print(p)
}

```{r coverage-detail-plots, eval=has_coverage, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
if (has_coverage && nrow(coverage_intervals) > 0) {
  detected_refs <- detail_df %>%
    filter(detected == "true", ref_length > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_coverage))

  max_detail_plots <- 100
  n_detail <- nrow(detected_refs)
  if (n_detail > max_detail_plots) {
    detected_refs <- detected_refs %>% slice_head(n = max_detail_plots)
    cat(sprintf('\n\n*Showing top %d of %d detected references by average coverage.*\n\n',
                max_detail_plots, n_detail))
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(detected_refs))) {
    ref_id <- detected_refs$reference_id[i]
    ref_cov <- detected_refs$avg_coverage[i]
    ref_len <- detected_refs$ref_length[i]
    pct5 <- detected_refs$pct_covered_5x[i]
    pct20 <- detected_refs$pct_covered_20x[i]
    ref_data <- expand_intervals(coverage_intervals %>% filter(reference_id == ref_id))

    if (nrow(ref_data) == 0) next

    cat(sprintf('\n\n<details><summary><strong>%s</strong> &mdash; %.1fX avg, %s bp, %.0f%% &ge;5X, %.0f%% &ge;20X</summary>\n\n',
                ref_id, ref_cov, format(ref_len, big.mark = ","), pct5, pct20))

    p <- ggplot(ref_data, aes(x = position, y = depth)) +
      geom_area(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e67e22", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "#e74c3c", linewidth = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 5, label = "5X", hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5,
               color = "#e67e22", size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 20, label = "20X", hjust = 1.2, vjust = -0.5,
               color = "#e74c3c", size = 3) +
      labs(x = "Genome Position", y = "Coverage Depth",
           title = sprintf("Coverage: %s", ref_id),
           subtitle = sprintf("%.1fX avg | %.0f%% \u22655X | %.0f%% \u226520X | %s bp",
                              ref_cov, pct5, pct20, format(ref_len, big.mark = ","))) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

    print(p)
    cat('\n\n</details>\n\n')
  }
}
```
